Dream? No! Now, now ’'m awake! O let them be, those unspeakably lovely figures! How deeply the dear sight moves me! Are they dream? Are they memory? Once before I felt myself so blest. Waters idle through cool, dense, swaying thickets, no rushing sound, no rustle, scarcely a ripple; and from every side numberless springs flow together to form this clear, clean, shallow pool for bathing. And there they play, young, healthy limbs of lovely women, seen twice over, to my eye's delight, in the liquid mirror of the waters. Some swim boldly, others wade timidly, till at last all join in a great white splash and shrieks and shouts and laughter. These should content me, my eyes should feast their fill, but my senses urge me on, and | turn my gaze toward that screen of thick foliage, that green veil that conceals the exalted queen. What a marvelous sight! Swans from hidden bays and inlets, swimming with simple but majestic dignity, floating silently, tenderly sociable, but nonetheless proud and self-assured: see how each moves his head and beak. But one of them seems more proud, more bold than the rest. Chest thrust forward,

梦想？不！现在，现在醒了！哦，随他们去吧，那些难以形容的可爱人物！这可爱的景象多么让我感动啊！他们是梦吗？它们是记忆吗？以前有一次我感觉自己是如此幸福。水流缓慢地流过凉爽、稠密、摇曳的灌木丛，没有奔流的声音，没有沙沙的声音，几乎没有涟漪；四面无数泉水汇流而下，形成这清澈洁净的浅水池，可供沐浴。他们在那里玩耍，年轻而健康的四肢可爱的女人，让我的眼睛高兴的是，在水面的液体镜中看到了两次。有些人勇敢地游泳，有些人则胆怯地涉水，直到最后所有人都加入到巨大的白色水花中，尖叫着、叫喊着、笑声不断。这些应该让我满意，我的眼睛应该饱饱的，但我的感官催促我继续前进，并且|将我的目光转向那层茂密的树叶，那层遮盖尊贵女王的绿色面纱。多么奇妙的景象啊！来自隐蔽海湾和水湾的天鹅，以简单而庄严的姿态游泳，静静地漂浮，温柔地社交，但仍然骄傲和自信：看看每只天鹅如何移动他的头和喙。但其中一位似乎比其他人更自豪、更大胆。胸部向前挺，
